eIMCI by D-Tree International is based on the IMCI Chart Booklet from the Tanzanian Ministry of Health.

IT IS FOR DEMONSTRATION PURPOSES ONLY!

choices.label: Is the child lethargic or unconscious

steps.label: CHECK FOR GENERAL DANGER SIGNS. LOOK:
CHECK FOR GENERAL DANGER SIGNS. ASK:
A child with any danger sign requires URGENT attention. Complete the assessment and any pre-referral treatment immediately so that referral is not delayed
ASK: What is the child's age (in years or months)
years old or  months old?
ASK: What is the child's weight in kg (skip if unknown)
SORRY: IMCI is meant for children under 19 kgs. Correct dosings may not be available. Do you want to continue anyway?
Ask about main symptoms
ASK: Just to check, does the child have any diarrhea?

choices.label: Yes, I will count number of breaths per minute
No, but breathing rate is normal
No, but breathing rate is fast

steps.label: Can you measure the breathing rate? (CHILD MUST BE CALM)
LOOK: Is the chest indrawing? (CHILD MUST BE CALM)
LOOK AND LISTEN: Is there stridor? (CHILD MUST BE CALM)
LOOK AND LISTEN: Is there wheeze? (CHILD MUST BE CALM)
Assess response of wheeze to broncodilator after 3 cycles
CLASSIFY: severe pneumonia with wheezing or very severe disease
ASK: Is there ear pain?
ASK: Is there ear discharge?
LOOK: Is pus draining from the ear?
FEEL: Is there tenderness or swelling behind the ear?
CLASSIFY: mastoiditis
This child requires URGENT referral to hospital. Is referral possible?
Which antibiotic would you like to use for the pneumonia?
GIVE: [itext:[amount unavailable for age/weight]] of 400,000u/mLPROCAINE PENICILLINonce a day for 5 days
An antibiotic has already been given for pneumonia; there is no need to give an additional antibiotic for the ear problem
Which paracetamol form would you like to use?
GIVE: [itext:[amount unavailable for age/weight]] of 500mgPARACETAMOLevery 6 hrs as needed
Explain how to give the treatment. Give the first treatment. Does the mother understand?
Soothe the throat and relieve the cough with a safe remedy
Give an inhaled or oral bronchodilator for 5 days
If coughing more than 14 days, refer for assessment
If recurrent wheezing, refer for assessment
Tell mother to return immediately if child is not able to drink/breastfeed, becomes sicker, or develops a fever
Follow up in 2 days
The protocol is complete. Thank you for using E-IMCI.
Refer URGENTLY to hospital!
